title: ScannerProfile
description: Which scanners the Software Factory runs, the SLSA level its builds must reach, and the evidence it keeps. One per tenant. These are the security.scanners, security.scanners.custom, security.slsa_min and security.evidence settings of the factory settings document: applying saves a new revision of that document, with one audit entry per changed setting, and a FactorySettings document never carries them, so the two kinds never write the same setting. A field left out means its default. Deleting the document puts all four settings back to their defaults.

scanners.description: The scanners a factory scan runs. minimum: software composition analysis, malware and secrets. all: every scanner. custom: the scanners listed in custom. The security.scanners setting.

custom.description: The scanner ids to run when scanners is custom; required then, and kept but unused otherwise. The security.scanners.custom setting.

slsaMin.description: The lowest SLSA build level the factory accepts for what it builds. The security.slsa_min setting.

evidence.description: The evidence kept for a build. cdx_slsa: a CycloneDX SBOM and SLSA provenance. sbom_only: the SBOM alone. The security.evidence setting.
